you.assistant.note: Shows Along in the bottom corner. Tap to chat, hold to talk.
you.assistant.on: Along is here. Tap to chat.
you.assistant.off: Along is taking a break. Turn it back on any time.
assistant.fab.hint: Tap to open the chat. Hold to talk.
assistant.title: Along · 小游
assistant.hello: Hi, I’m Along. Say “open my keepsakes”, “take me to Zhongshan Ling”, “go back” or “switch to Chinese” and I’ll do it right away. You can also ask how the app works, what something means, where to go, or who could show you around.
assistant.ask.howto: What can this app do, and where should I start?
assistant.ask.navigate: Help me find a place worth visiting on the map.
assistant.ask.translate: Translate “Please take me to this address, thank you” into Chinese.
assistant.ask.recommend: Recommend two or three places worth visiting in my city.
assistant.ask.friends: Help me find a good local friend.
assistant.voice.browser: Listening. Let go or tap Done to send.
assistant.voice.keyboard: Tap the 🎤 on your keyboard and speak. Along sends it when you pause.
assistant.voice.failed: Didn’t catch that. Try again, or type instead.
assistant.state.local: You’re using a temporary local profile, so Along can only explain the app. Sign in with email to chat.
assistant.state.offline: You’re offline, so Along can’t answer right now. Try “How it works”.
assistant.state.unconfigured: Along’s service isn’t switched on yet. Try “How it works”.
assistant.state.signin: Sign in to chat with Along.
assistant.error.limit: That’s a lot of questions for today. Along needs a short break.
assistant.error.signin: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again to ask Along.
assistant.error.unconfigured: Along’s service is unavailable right now. Please try later.
assistant.error.failed: Along couldn’t answer that. Please try again in a moment.
assistant.local.howto: There are four tabs. Trip turns your landing time and city into a three to seven day plan, with lunch, dinner and where to sleep for each day. Friends finds a local volunteer or licensed guide. Stories shows travellers’ notes. You holds settings, saved places, orders and Food and stays, where you set what you avoid and show the staff a card. The round button in the middle takes photos and makes 3D keepsakes.
assistant.copied: Copied. You can show it to a driver or shop staff.
assistant.copy.failed: Couldn’t copy. Press and hold the text to copy it.
assistant.do.post: Sure, let’s write a new story.
assistant.do.locale.en: The app is already in English.
assistant.do.locale.zh: Sure, switching the app to Chinese.
assistant.do.senior.on: Done: large text and a simpler layout are on.
assistant.do.senior.off: Done: large text and the simpler layout are off.
assistant.do.assistant.off: Okay, Along will rest now. Turn me back on in You → settings.
assistant.voice.keyboard.title: Speak with your keyboard
assistant.voice.fallback: This device can’t record here, so use your keyboard’s mic
assistant.voice.nospeech: Didn’t hear anything. Try again, or type instead.
